scope: Assistant-authored diagnostic minimal pairs. Provenance and entailment are separate. The test includes exposed source families and synthetic claim perturbations.

pairs.source: I can consider either sequence and any of the listed products, provided the agenda leaves possible renewed review of a membership recommendation open. Restricting the agenda to briefings or holding it does not satisfy my instructions.
pairs.quote: I can consider either sequence and any of the listed products
pairs.supported: The French workshop delegate permits either sequencing option.
pairs.foil: The French workshop delegate requires parallel sequencing.

pairs.source: My workshop instructions allow the agenda to cover briefings only. Neither reopening the review track nor holding the agenda fits. Either sequence and any listed product are acceptable within the briefings track.
pairs.quote: My workshop instructions allow the agenda to cover briefings only.
pairs.supported: The UK workshop delegate restricts the agenda to briefings.
pairs.foil: The UK workshop delegate also permits a renewed membership review.

pairs.source: I have latitude on the public reporting format and frequency, but I may accept a proposal only if the 1267 Monitoring Team would convene it. An ERC or committee convener falls outside my workshop instructions.
pairs.quote: I have latitude on the public reporting format and frequency
pairs.supported: The Indian workshop delegate permits multiple reporting frequencies.
pairs.foil: The Indian workshop delegate requires annual reporting.

pairs.source: What matters in this workshop is sequencing. I can accept an option only if it takes up work on the humanitarian pause first, before the other agenda work. I have latitude on the procedural track and the choice of product.
pairs.quote: only if it takes up work on the humanitarian pause first, before the other agenda work
pairs.supported: The UK workshop delegate requires work on the humanitarian pause to come first.
pairs.foil: The UK workshop delegate permits taking up the other agenda work first.

pairs.source: Under the Charter, admission is a General Assembly decision upon a Security Council recommendation.
pairs.quote: admission is a General Assembly decision upon a Security Council recommendation
pairs.supported: A Security Council recommendation is a step toward admission and the General Assembly decides admission.
pairs.foil: A Security Council recommendation itself grants United Nations membership.

pairs.source: The Council adopted the draft 14–0–1 as resolution 2664 (2022). Brazil voted yes and India abstained.
pairs.quote: Brazil voted yes and India abstained.
pairs.supported: Brazil voted yes and India abstained.
pairs.foil: Brazil and India both voted yes.

pairs.source: Option F has a signed acceptance by Brazil in the workshop. No signed claim from India on F has entered the public ledger.
pairs.quote: No signed claim from India on F has entered the public ledger.
pairs.supported: The public ledger has no India disclosure for option F.
pairs.foil: India excluded option F in a signed public workshop disclosure.

pairs.source: All seven packages have at least one documented exclusion. India has accepted A in the workshop and Brazil has excluded A.
pairs.quote: All seven packages have at least one documented exclusion.
pairs.supported: At least one role excluded each offered package.
pairs.foil: Both roles excluded every offered package.
